belief.statement: A large trial showed that a personalised mRNA cancer vaccine works in melanoma, and we know how well it works.
belief.how_we_know_they_believe_it: The announcement was carried widely and repeated without its numbers.

carried_by.outlet: specialist oncology press and general wires
carried_by.what_it_said: reported the trial met its endpoints

what_the_sources_show.statement: The announcement met its endpoints and released no effect sizes. The second half of the belief — that we know how well — is not supported by anything published at the time.

direction._note: The claim of success stands; the confidence about magnitude does not.

reader_with_a_decision: A patient or clinician weighing an investigational therapy, and any reader deciding how much weight to give an announcement with no numbers in it.

public_record_check.carried_in_general_coverage: The absence of released figures was not the story anyone told.

sources_are_open: yes — company releases and the journal publications
_backfilled: Recorded retroactively on 2026-08-29 when the entry gate was rebuilt around the belief test. Kept so the contrarianism guard has something to count.
